optimizer: float64 full-history L-BFGS-B; analytic sparse gradient; equal-player objective
training_scope: Only the frozen 14 development histories. Every trained arm completes before any new validation scoring. No epochs, weights, arms, or thresholds added after outcomes.
objective_scope: All trained arms use mean-player NLL plus 0.001/2 times mean-player squared effective coefficients. Auxiliary arm uses the original auxiliary weights, but deterministic next-alphabetic wrong identity and full-history per-player behavior moments instead of random minibatch estimates; this is an objective-family diagnostic, not an exact reproduction of the original optimizer.
opportunity_objective: Equal-player, equal-supported-phase/attribute mean squared distribution distance (one half sum of squared category-rate errors), on history opportunities only. Original style-metric Boolean, moved-piece and destination-wing attributes; forced attributes excluded; minimum 20 opportunities. No validation target moments.
selection_rule: Eligible finite completed arm must improve macro style TV over matched-history v1 by at least 0.0001, beat its own equal-player shared and next-alphabetic wrong controls, have NLL no worse than its shared control and exact accuracy no more than 0.02 below shared. Choose smallest TV among passing arms; declaration order breaks ties. Parity is never selectable. Report optimizer convergence separately; an iteration-limit arm is diagnostic only and ineligible.
held_out_scope: Development validation only, with the original cross-player held-out quarantine. Six reserved players remain unadapted and unscored; original v1 confirmation remains unopened.
evidence_status: Retrospective development-only objective/optimization ablation on previously inspected local players; no promotion, independent confirmation, strength or autonomous-style claim.
